    while (b) {
        if (b & 1) res = (res * a) % mod;
        a = (a * a) % mod;
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

    scanf("%lld %lld", &p, &k);
    const ll MOD = 1000000007;
    const int MAX = 1000003;
    ll inv[MAX];

            ans = (ans * p) % MOD;

        ll cur = 1;

            cur = (cur * k) % p;
            if (cur == 1) {
                order = i;
                break;
            }
        }
        if (k == 1) {
            ans = 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i)
